title: Pañcālacaṇḍo
text: 1. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Pañcālacaṇḍo devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Sambādhe vata okāsaṃ || avindi bhūrimedhaso || yo jhānam abuddhi buddho || patilīnanisabho munīti || || 2. Sambādhe vāpi vindanti || (Pañcālacaṇḍāti Bhagavā) || dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā || ye satiṃ paccalatthaṃsu || sammā te susamāhitā ti || || [page 049] II. 1. 8] PAṬHAMA-VAGGA 1. 49
